title: Raj - Leaf blower
description: A plugin that adds simple leaf blower to quickly get rid of annoying leaf litter in forests.
body:
# Leaf Blower: Say Goodbye to Leaf Litter!

Tired of Minecraft’s dumbest addition to forests? This plugin provides a fast, satisfying way to clear out the clutter and keep your world looking pristine. **(Seriously, I really, really hate this block).**

### Why even use a Leaf Blower?
Is that even a question? **It is everywhere on the ground.** This thing is literally useless except for some niche fuel farms (which are replaceable with better variants), and it’s always in the way when you want to build something nice in an oak forest and it looks stupid.

![I hate leaf litter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/26e349eea3dd6a8c30884f16faa397b42d8371a2.jpeg) 

With this plugin, you can simply **equip a Leaf Blower** and start cleaning up instantly! No more clicking every single tiny block—only to miss it anyway because it has a stupid hitbox. It's annoying, it looks bad, and now it's gone.

---

### Key Features
* **Quick Cleanup:** Efficiently remove leaf litter in an area around you.
* **Simple Setup:** Get your tool quickly with a straightforward command.
* **Fully Customizable:** You aren't limited to just this **atrocity**! Through the config, you can set the blower to remove:
    * 🌿 Short & Tall Grass
    * 🌸 Flowers
    * 🍄 Mushrooms
    * ...and any other decorative blocks that get on your nerves!

---

### How to Use
1. Use the command to get the Leaf Blower (e.g., `/leafblower give`).
2. Hold it in your hand.
3. Clean up the forest and finally enjoy a tidy landscape!

---

### ⚙️ Configuration
The plugin is designed to be flexible. Want to clear out a flower field or a swamp full of seagrass? Just add the block IDs to the configuration file, and your Leaf Blower is ready to delete whatever you hate next.
